<function=python>

def nbar():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            nr=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; return (min(nr),max(nr))
    return None
def player():
    b=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['pixels']==8 and n['color']=='b'][0]
    bc=[p[1] for p in b['boundary']]; return (min(bc),max(bc))
def stepinfo():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']>50:
            r=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; c=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(r),max(r),min(c),max(c),n['pixels'])
    return None
print("start:", "N",nbar(),"player",player(),"bar",stepinfo())
for i in range(5):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"L{i+1}:", "N",nbar(),"player",player(),"bar",stepinfo(),
          "done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"lvl:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),"go:",last_action_result.get('game_over'))
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("STOP"); break
